body:
Built (book v146), Model Compare → Pet Show → Pet Show area (with people / empty). There is also a new card for the judges' table alone.
Layout, all on one sand show lawn on the west side of the park, facing the fountain:
1) Stage: at today's spot (-36.5, 22), front toward the fountain.
2) Podium: BESIDE the stage, not in front, at (-36.0, 16.9). It faces the fountain too, so it never blocks the view.
3) Judges' table: at the other front corner (-33.8, 27.3), turned toward the stage, outside the rope. 3 judges, name plates, score paddles 9/10/8, a gold bell. 3.0 x 1.1 x 1.3 units.
4) Low gold rope with a gap in the middle. The audience stands between the rope and the fountain.
Change to the park: the tree at (-37.4, 16.2) moves to (-39.2, 13.4) to make room for the podium. Map chat to confirm.
Reviewer: 7 → 8 → 9/10. Nothing blocks the stage from the audience. Leftover: the playground slide stands close behind the judges (not touching).
short: OK'd 31 Oct: the whole Pet Show area. In the model pack
source: Karolis 31 Oct: podium cannot be in the way of the stage; see the whole area in the park
title: Pet Show area in Cozy Park: stage, podium, judges' table
